**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Full audit of brain (feature/v2.0.0) → decide mergeability + usability by other projects → scans → epic action plan → 7-premise design-conformance scorecard → reviewer mechanism comparison → 1.0 release artifacts → CUT 1.0. Session ended with v1.0.0 tagged on main and the 1.1 path recorded.

## Instructions / decisions (durable)
- Release: cut 1.0 as a CONTROLLED PILOT (own repos / Sinergia). Auto-update-safety does NOT block 1.0 (self-owned risk); it is the HARD GATE before opening to external adopters. Public tag = 1.0 → next line = 1.1 (not 2.1). DONE — v1.0.0 tagged.
- 1.1 FIRST ITEM = #210 (fix release-gate ordering), promoted to top out of M6 (proved failing live at the cut). Order: #210 → M2 → M3 → M4 → M5 → M8 → M6(rest) → M7; M0 housekeeping parallel.
- Role neutrality: C (role-as-port, #312/ADR-0023 draft) now → B (reference roles) later. M8 = per-stage engine routing (stage→engine map), consciously SUPERSEDES ADR-0019.
- Reviewer: add inline per-line comments (brain-review/2 comments[], GitLab discussions parity, stays event:COMMENT per ADR-0020) + consider a PANEL mode (dual-blind consensus).
- Governance rule respected throughout: agent NEVER applies status:approved (#124) — that is the human maintainer's signature.

## Discoveries / gotchas (reusable)
- main IS protected (5 required checks: issue-link, diff-size, local-checks, memory-gate, decision-gate). Releases go via a governance PR, not a direct push.
- `gh pr/issue edit --add-label` SILENTLY FAILS (GraphQL projects-classic). Use REST: `gh api --method POST repos/OWNER/REPO/issues/<n>/labels -f "labels[]=<label>"`.
- Editing brain/HOME.md drifts AGENTS.md (generated from 5 SOURCE_DOCS incl HOME.md) → antigravity.drift.test.mjs fails local-checks. Regenerate AGENTS.md (import SOURCE_DOCS/AGENTS_EMIT_PATH/compileAgentsMd from antigravity.mjs, read sources, writeFileSync). AGENTS.md is in governance.ignoreList (no diff-size cost).
- Approving the ISSUE does NOT re-run the PR workflow → `gh run rerun <run> --failed` to re-evaluate issue-link.
- Bumping version requires README (readme-version.test asserts `#v<version>`, 7 refs) + CHANGELOG `## v<version>` + package.json.
- release.yml fires on tag push but runs AFTER the tag exists (#210) → can't block; showed `failure` at the v1.0.0 cut (harmless for pilot). This is WHY #210 is 1.1's first item.
- commit-msg hook REQUIRES a #N ticket reference.

## Accomplished
- Audit: 3 rounds (9 scan agents) + judgment-day (2 judges) on the reviewer. Scorecard avg ~63% (strong: memory/evolutive-memory/VCS; weak: SDD stage-config 40%, reviewer 45%; tokens 50% unmeasured).
- Reviewer CRITICAL confirmed (#317): prReviews returns no body → priorVerdicts always empty → anti-loop/rev-bound/board inert; refuter dead code; findings no round-trip. Security boundary sound.
- 1.0 CUT COMPLETE: PR #318 (ADR-0024 G3 + allow-list trim G4 + audit docs) → feature/v2.0.0; PR #320 (release: cut v1.0.0) → main (mergeCommit 9d66221); tag v1.0.0 pushed; #319 closed. package.json=1.0.0.
- All audit artifacts committed on main (verified).
- Tickets: epic #313; #312 role-port; #317 reviewer bug; #314 dup-267-dir; #315 hook-dedup; #316 .env-unify; #319 release (closed).

## Next Steps (1.1, starts from repo)
1. Approve #210 (maintainer signature) → first 1.1 PR = fix release-gate ordering; fold the MASTER-PLAN/epic doc reorder into it.
2. Then M2 (#123, #315, #316) → M3 (#317 + inline reviewer) → M4 (dist + auto-update-safety = the external-adoption gate) → M5 (#312) → M8 (per-stage routing) → M6(rest) → M7.
3. M0 housekeeping anytime: close #217/#222, #314, .gitignore .memory/chunks.
4. 1.1 slices branch off MAIN (feature/v2.0.0 now merged/retired).

## Relevant Files (on main)
- docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md — entry point
- docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md — M0-M8 epic + release strategy (#210 first)
- docs/inbox/brain-v2-merge-audit.md — audit + 7-premise scorecard
- docs/inbox/reviewer-mechanisms-comparison.md — judgment-day vs brain-reviewer
- docs/KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md — 1.0 pilot scope
- brain/project/decisions/adr-0024-three-axis-decoupling.md
- brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md — draft for M5
- brain/scripts/review/ + reviewer-protocol.md — #317 lives here
- Engram topic keys: architecture/{v2-merge-audit,v2-epic-plan,v2-conformance-scorecard,sdd-role-neutrality,per-stage-engine-routing,release-strategy-1.0,remaining-path-1.1}; review/priorverdicts-inert-bug; release/pr-318-merged
